experiment_data.hypothesis: EC-HTE with HB partial pooling degrades gracefully under subgroup misspecification: mild noise (10%) causes minimal performance loss due to shrinkage toward global, moderate noise (25%) reduces but preserves advantage over global correction, and severe noise (50%) may eliminate EC-HTE's advantage — demonstrating both the method's robustness range and its honest limitation

spec.data_count: 800 MC runs (2 configs × 4 noise levels × 100 MC)
